How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Delhi Consultant (Training & Placement) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Delhi Consultant (Training & Placement) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the NIT Delhi Consultant (Training & Placement) position is 16-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant (Training & Placement) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Consultant (Training & Placement) post at NIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree with a minimum of 55% marks in MBA (Finance), MBA (Marketing), MBA (Human Resource), or MBA with any other specialization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Consultant (Training & Placement) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Consultant (Training & Placement) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Consultant (Training & Placement) post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online for this recruitment through the official NIT Delhi website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Delhi located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Delhi is located in Delhi.
